value.rationale: The motivating 2023 test-house study identifies long-lived VOC reservoirs and physically effective surface removal, so optimizing one cleaning within an exposure window is a natural quantitative decision. The unique clock depends solely on the two measurable uncleaned decay modes, avoiding separate estimation of three physical coefficients and cleaning strength; the 1/3-to-reservoir-peak progression distinguishes short and long exposure windows. This is a meaningful theory benchmark with no field effectiveness or policy calibration asserted.
